use std.resource.{ResourceError}

data IoError:
    message: string

trait FileHandle:
    fn read!(mut self) -> Result[string, ResourceError[IoError]]
    fn close(mut self) -> Result[void, ResourceError[IoError]]

fn read_after_close!(handle: mut FileHandle) -> Result[string, ResourceError[IoError]]:
    _ := handle.close()?
    handle.read!()
